note: Zero-cost configuration: only documented free allowances, no billing. The paid configuration remains in models.json. Nothing is billed in this mode, so the money budget is replaced by a free-quota guard (experiments/ratelimit.py) and a Groq plan-header guard that aborts if a paid plan is detected.

budget.fx_source: ECB 2026-11-18 (only used for the reference 'would-have-cost' figure)

limits.source: Owner-confirmed from the Google AI Studio rate-limit dashboard for this project, 2026-11-19: 15 requests/min, 250,000 input tokens/min, 500 requests/day (dashboard peak usage then 5/15 RPM, 3.48K/250K TPM, 38/500 RPD). Google publishes no such table in its docs. No per-day token limit is shown, so tpd 1,000,000 is a conservative assumption (the whole run reserves about 55,000). Calls are deliberately paced at 9 requests/min (pace_rpm), below the 15 RPM ceiling.

price.source: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing (paid Standard tier, reference only; the Free tier column reads 'Free of charge')

models.notes: Free tier only if the API key belongs to a Google Cloud project WITHOUT a linked billing account (a billing-linked project is a paid tier). Free-tier prompts and responses may be read by human reviewers and used to improve Google products: only the public, non-personal CNMI schedule text is sent. temperature is not sent (deprecated for Gemini 3.x); thinkingLevel MINIMAL; generateContent endpoint.

limits.source: https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (Free Plan Limits table, freeRows in the page data)

models.notes: Production model, 131,072 context, 65,536 max output. Reasoning model: effort low is its minimum (none is not available), reasoning excluded from the response; reasoning tokens still consume the output cap. Strict json_schema supported.

limits.source: https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (Free Plan Limits table, freeRows in the page data)

models.notes: PREVIEW model (Groq: for evaluation only, may be withdrawn without notice). 131,072 context, 16,384 max output. reasoning_effort none = instruct mode, no reasoning tokens. Strict json_schema supported.

retry.note: Longer back-off than the default (1 s): Gemini returned HTTP 503 (overloaded) in the first full-run attempt, and every attempt counts against the free quota.
